mentions.name: MedAngle
mentions.description: MedAngle is an all-in-one super app for current and future doctors, combining study resources with 150m+ questions solved, smarter studying time tracking, and AI tools MedGPT and MedAgent for medical and dental students and recent graduates.
mentions.audience: Medical and dental students and young doctors who have recently graduated
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on MedAngle, the world's first Super App for current and future doctors.

100k+ users, 150m+ questions solved, 60b seconds of smarter studying, MedGPT, MedAgent, and everything medical/dental students need in one place along with young doctors who have recently graduated
